verdict.reason: views.py:11 takes the url parameter from any unauthenticated request, validators.py:14-18 resolves the hostname once and checks the IPs, and views.py:14 calls requests.get(url) which resolves the hostname again at connect time with no pinning, so a short-TTL rebinding answer can swap in 127.0.0.1 or 169.254.169.254 after the check. My check is from Python ipaddress semantics (not executed, since only Read/Grep/Glob are allowed); the 100.64.0.0/10 range is not in ipaddress's private or reserved lists, so is_private and is_reserved are False there.
